_doc: Factory repo profile for insurance-app-base (FACTORY.md §2c). Originally written on issue #83 and re-verified on #93, #98, #104 and now #123; the factory teardown/re-enable cycle that runs alongside Factory Console testing keeps deleting this file from main (most recently commit 47e31c3) while restoring the rest of the footprint, so a missing profile.json means the file needs re-adding, not that the repo's facts changed. `git diff --stat c95c9cb HEAD -- backend/ frontend/ docker-compose.yml` is empty: no application code has changed since the #104 verification, the only commits since being FACTORY_CANARY.md and the openspec/changes/116-category-type-field spec folder. Every command below was re-executed in this run and every stack fact re-checked against HEAD; the single thing that changed is the appearance of a `staging` branch on the remote — see the staging gotcha, which is the whole reason this run opened a PR rather than reporting 'no change'. See templates/profile.schema.json in claude-software-factory for field docs.
estate_role: Standalone full-stack monorepo — the Spring Boot backend and the React/Vite frontend live in this one repo and ship as one Docker Compose unit. No sibling repos in this estate, so every epic is filed here and there is no cross-repo merge order to derive. Note that genai-jerry/insurance-app-ui exists and looks like a sibling from its name, but it is a stale whole-repo duplicate of this project (same backend/ + frontend/ layout, last pushed 2026-02-15) with no contract relationship to this repo — do not treat an epic here as cross-repo on account of it.
stack: Backend: Java 21 (source/target 21, requires a JDK 21 toolchain), Spring Boot 3.2.2, Spring Security + JWT (jjwt 0.12.5), Spring Data JPA, Spring AI 1.0.0-M4 (OpenAI chat/embeddings + pgvector store), Flyway 10, Lombok 1.18.36 + MapStruct 1.6.3, Twilio SDK, Apache Tika, OpenHTMLtoPDF, OpenCSV, springdoc-openapi, Micrometer/Prometheus, Maven. Frontend: React 18, TypeScript 5.3, Vite 5, Material-UI 5, TanStack Query 5, Zustand 4, react-hook-form, react-beautiful-dnd, axios, Vitest 1 + Testing Library. Database: PostgreSQL 16 with the pgvector extension (pgvector/pgvector:pg16). Infra: Docker + Docker Compose.

commands.test: cd backend && mvn -B test && cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm test
commands.build: cd backend && mvn -B clean package -DskipTests && cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm run build

conventions: Backend is organised by domain module under backend/src/main/java/com/insurance/{module}, each with controller/, dto/, service/, repository/ (plus mapper/ and exception/ where the module needs them). The modules are: auth, leads, products, scheduler, voice, rag, prospectus, email, admin. Two packages are not modules and are not patterns to copy: common/ (entities only) and test/, which holds a single leftover demo endpoint (TestController, GET /test/hello, returns a bare String with no DTO, service or springdoc annotation).

JPA entities live only in common/entity/ and are shared across modules — never declare an entity inside a feature module, and never return one from a controller; controllers return DTOs from the module's dto/ package.

Controllers are @RestController + @RequestMapping("/api/...") + @RequiredArgsConstructor + @Slf4j, with constructor injection via final fields. Endpoints carry springdoc @Tag/@Operation/@Parameter annotations, take @Valid request bodies, and return ResponseEntity<T>.
Services are @Service + @RequiredArgsConstructor + @Slf4j and annotate read paths @Transactional(readOnly = true); business logic belongs here, not in controllers.
Repositories are Spring Data JPA interfaces annotated @Repository. Custom queries use @Query JPQL with @Param-bound parameters — never string-concatenated user input into the query structure.
Nullable String parameters in a JPQL @Query must be wrapped as CAST(:param AS string) (see ProductRepository.findByFilters, lines 35-37) — see the bytea gotcha below.

Schema changes are a new forward-only Flyway migration at backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V{next}__{description}.sql; never edit an applied migration. Current head is V13__add_phone_to_users.sql, so the next is V14.

Entity<->DTO conversion is either a MapStruct @Mapper(componentModel = "spring", unmappedTargetPolicy = ReportingPolicy.IGNORE) interface (leads/mapper/) or a private toDto() helper in the service (products/service/) — follow whichever the module you are editing already uses rather than introducing the other. Note that leads/mapper/LeadMapper exists but LeadService still converts by hand, so the MapStruct path is declared more than it is used.

Frontend pages live under frontend/src/pages/agent/, frontend/src/pages/admin/ or frontend/src/pages/auth/ (the unauthenticated login / forgot-password / reset-password screens). A new page gets an axios client in frontend/src/api/, TypeScript types mirroring the backend DTO in frontend/src/types/index.ts, a route in App.tsx, and a Sidebar.tsx entry if it needs navigation.

All frontend HTTP goes through the shared axios instance in frontend/src/api/client.ts (baseURL '/api', bearer token from localStorage 'auth_token', 401 redirect) — do not create new axios instances. Per-domain modules export a plain object of async functions (e.g. productsApi.getAll).
Frontend server state goes through TanStack Query; auth/global UI state goes through the Zustand store in frontend/src/store/ — not ad hoc React context.

Frontend form validation is react-hook-form's own inline rules (register('email', { required, pattern })). zod is a declared dependency but no form uses it — do not introduce zod schemas into an existing form as an incidental change.
review_checklist: New or changed endpoints declare the @PreAuthorize the module already uses — hasRole('ADMIN') for admin-only, hasAnyRole('ADMIN','AGENT') for agent-facing. SecurityConfig only requires authentication for anything outside /, /ping, /api/auth/**, /api-docs/**, /swagger-ui/**, /swagger-ui.html and /actuator/**, so a missing annotation silently means 'any logged-in user'.

Agent-scoped reads must derive the agent from the Authentication, not trust a client-supplied agentId: LeadController computes an effectiveAgentId and forces it to the caller's own id unless the caller is ADMIN, and returns 403 when an agent fetches a lead assigned to someone else. A new lead/prospect query that skips this leaks other agents' leads.

products/controller/* (ProductController, ProductCategoryController, ProductDocumentController) currently carry NO @PreAuthorize at all — any authenticated user, agent included, can create/update/delete products. If a task touches these, treat adding authorization as a deliberate decision to raise, not an incidental change.
Any new table or column ships with a new V{n}__ Flyway migration rather than a rewrite of an existing one.
New @Query JPQL binds user input via @Param and wraps nullable String params in CAST(:p AS string).

org.springframework.web* logging levels stay at INFO in the committed defaults — DispatcherServlet logs the query string at DEBUG, which would write PII (?email=, ?search=) into the application log. application.yml lines 118-122 carry a comment saying so. Raise per-environment via WEB_LOG_LEVEL only.
No secrets, API keys or credential-bearing URLs in code, migrations, tests or docker-compose defaults.
RAG recommendation output stays grounded in retrieved product IDs (rag/service/RecommendationService maps embeddings back to real Product rows) rather than free-form LLM text.
qa_notes: Backend tests are JUnit 5 + AssertJ + Mockito under backend/src/test/java, mirroring the main package layout, and named after the behaviour under test (e.g. ProductRepositoryNameFilterTest). Related cases are grouped in @Nested inner classes with @DisplayName. 6 test classes exist (auth, products, admin) holding 82 @Test/@ParameterizedTest methods, which expand to more executed cases because the @ParameterizedTest ones are ValueSource-driven.

Measured live in this run on a machine with no Docker daemon: `mvn -B test` reports 'Tests run: 76, Failures: 0, Errors: 2' — 74 real cases pass and the 2 errors are the two Testcontainers-backed repository classes failing at container startup, not assertion failures. A run with Docker available additionally executes those two classes' 27 methods; the prior verified run on such a machine reported 99 total. Use 74-passing/2-container-errors as the no-Docker baseline.

Backend test layering, as practised in the existing suites: service tests are @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) with @Mock repositories and @InjectMocks; controller tests are @WebMvcTest(X.class) + @Import(SecurityConfig.class) with MockMvc, @MockBean service/JwtAuthenticationFilter and @WithMockUser, covering authorization plus request-parameter binding; repository tests are @DataJpaTest against a real database.

Repository tests use Testcontainers, NOT H2: @DataJpaTest builds the persistence unit from every entity in common/entity/, which uses jsonb, vector(1536) and text[] — none of which H2 can model. They start PostgreSQLContainer on pgvector/pgvector:pg16 with .withInitScript("db/init/01-init-pgvector.sql") and wire it in with @ServiceConnection. That init script is required: V4__create_vector_embeddings_table.sql uses vector(1536) but no migration creates the extension, so Flyway fails at V4 without it. com.h2database:h2 is still declared test-scoped in backend/pom.xml but no test uses it — do not take its presence as a signal that H2 is the test database.

Repository tests therefore need a running Docker daemon. Where Docker is unavailable they are the only tests that cannot run; service and controller tests still cover normalisation, binding and authorization.

backend/src/test/resources/application.properties sets spring.ai.openai.api-key=test — application.yml's one placeholder with no default. Any new test that loads the AI configuration needs it to stay.

Frontend tests are Vitest + React Testing Library + user-event, colocated with the component as <Component>.test.tsx. jsdom environment and globals are configured in vite.config.ts; frontend/src/test/setup.ts imports @testing-library/jest-dom/vitest. 16 tests across 3 files (ProductManagement 8, UserManagement 6, Login 2) — re-ran `npm test` this run, all 16 pass in ~4s.
Frontend tests mock the api/ module with vi.mock and render the page inside a QueryClientProvider built with retry:false — see ProductManagement.test.tsx as the reference pattern.
Voice flows should be exercised with VOICE_MOCK_MODE=true (the application.yml default) so no real OpenAI Realtime or Twilio calls are made.
gotchas: commands.test exits 1 on any machine without a Docker daemon, and it fails at the FIRST half of the chain — so the frontend half never runs. Verified in this run: the composed command stopped after the backend's 2 Testcontainers errors and vitest was never invoked. When Docker is unavailable, run the two halves separately (`cd backend && mvn -B test` and `cd frontend && npm ci && npm test`) so the frontend suite is not silently skipped, and judge your delta against the 74-pass/2-container-error backend baseline rather than treating the red build as something you caused.

The build needs a JDK 21, and the Lombok failure documented in KNOWN_ISSUES.md is specific to certain JDK 21 builds rather than to Java 21 generally. maven-compiler-plugin 3.13.0 is configured <source>21</source><target>21</target> (not <release>), and Eclipse Temurin 21.0.5 fails Lombok annotation processing with 'java.lang.ExceptionInInitializerError: com.sun.tools.javac.code.TypeTag :: UNKNOWN'. This run corrects what earlier profile runs had to record: on Debian OpenJDK 21.0.12.1 (installed via apt in this sandbox), `mvn -B clean package -DskipTests` reaches BUILD SUCCESS and `mvn -B test` compiles and runs the suite, with no Lombok error at all — 'Compiling 105 source files with javac [forked debug parameters release 21]' succeeds. So mvn IS runnable here; if you hit the TypeTag error, the fix is a different JDK 21 distribution (Debian/Corretto/a newer Temurin patch), not Docker and not a code change. Docker (`docker build backend/`, image maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21-alpine) remains a working fallback per KNOWN_ISSUES.md Option 1.

Admin settings are NOT really encrypted. AdminSettingService.encrypt/decrypt (lines 146-160) are plain Base64 and the code says so ('In production, use proper encryption like AES'), despite README/CLAUDE.md describing settings as encrypted. Do not rely on that column to protect a secret, and do not describe it as encryption in new work.

Nullable String parameters in JPQL must be CAST(:p AS string) on PostgreSQL. Hibernate otherwise infers bytea for a null-valued String parameter and the query fails at runtime — fixed once already in ProductRepository.findByFilters (commit 99fba33, 'fix: bind findByFilters String params typed to stop bytea coercion'). Repeating the untyped pattern reintroduces the bug, and only the Testcontainers repository tests catch it, so it will pass a no-Docker test run.

`npm run lint` is defined in frontend/package.json but cannot run: there is no ESLint config anywhere in the repo (no .eslintrc*, no eslint.config.*, no eslintConfig key), so ESLint 8.57.1 exits 2 with 'ESLint couldn't find a configuration file'. Re-confirmed this run. That is why commands.lint is null. Type checking still happens — `npm run build` runs tsc before vite build (re-confirmed this run, succeeds).

CLAUDE.md and README.md describe CI/CD workflows (ci.yml, cd.yml, deploy.yml) that do not exist. Re-confirmed this run: .github/ contains only ISSUE_TEMPLATE/, factory-approvers.json, factory-models.json and factory-orchestrator.json — there is no workflows/ directory at all. There is no CI and no deploy automation reachable from this repo's own state; do not assume any pipeline will catch anything you did not run yourself. (This repo's factory runs on the langgraph engine per .github/factory-orchestrator.json, which is why no Actions stub is present.) A branch named `staging` does now exist on the remote, but nothing deploys from it — see the staging gotcha below; earlier revisions of this profile said 'no staging branch' here and that half of the sentence is now wrong.

CLAUDE.md says the latest migration is V11 and the next is V12; it is actually V13, next V14 (re-confirmed this run by listing backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/). Trust the migration directory over the docs.

Swagger UI and /api-docs are both disabled by default in application.yml (springdoc.api-docs.enabled=false, springdoc.swagger-ui.enabled=false) even though SecurityConfig permits their paths — they are not reachable without flipping those flags.

The default seed credentials (admin@insurance.com / Admin@123, agent@insurance.com / Agent@123) come from the V10/V11 migrations and are dev-only seed data — never treat them as secrets to rotate, and never let them reach a real deployment.

The frontend production bundle is a single ~612 kB chunk (611.76 kB this run) and Vite warns 'Some chunks are larger than 500 kB' on every build. Pre-existing baseline noise, not something your delta introduced.

Frontend tests print 'React Router Future Flag Warning' on stderr for any test that renders a router (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) — re-confirmed this run. The suite still passes; baseline noise, not a failure in your delta.

A cold Maven repository makes the first backend command very slow — dependency resolution alone took several minutes in this run before compilation started (Spring AI, Tika, PDFBox and Twilio pull a large tree). Allow for that before concluding a backend build has hung.

A branch named `staging` exists on the remote, but branches.staging is deliberately still null and PRs must keep basing on main. Created 2026-08-24T14:23:04Z by genai-jerry (repo CreateEvent) pointing at 07e362f, which was main's tip at the time. As of this run it is 0 commits ahead of main and 44 behind (`git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...origin/staging` -> '44  0'), not one of the 51 pull requests ever opened in this repo has had it as a base (all 51 base on main), and no workflow, docker-compose service or doc references it. The schema defines branches.staging as 'Release-train branch, or null if the repo deploys from default' — this repo deploys from default, so null is the accurate value and setting it would send every implementer PR to a base missing 44 commits of main (including the approved openspec spec folders a task depends on), showing main's whole backlog as the diff. If the owner does intend to run the staging train per FACTORY.md §6, the branch must first be fast-forwarded to main and given something that actually deploys, and this field flipped to "staging" in the same change.

The whole factory footprint (.claude/, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/, .github/factory-*.json, openspec/) has been added and removed from main repeatedly during Factory Console testing, and .factory/profile.json is caught in that churn even when the rest of the footprint is restored — if profile.json is missing at HEAD, that does not mean the repo's underlying facts changed, only that the file needs re-adding.

notes: These are the local/Compose checks — the only ones this repo gives evidence for. There is no deploy workflow and no known staging or production hostname in the repo, so substitute the real host if one exists rather than assuming these URLs reach a deployed environment. A `staging` branch exists on the remote but has no environment behind it (see the staging gotcha), so there is still nothing to promote to and no staging URL to health-check.

The actuator health check mirrors docker-compose.yml's own backend healthcheck (re-confirmed this run, line 62: wget -qO- http://localhost:8080/actuator/health | grep -q '"status":"UP"'); management.endpoints.web.exposure.include lists health, info, metrics, prometheus and mappings, and SecurityConfig permits /actuator/** unauthenticated. health show-details is when-authorized, so an unauthenticated curl returns status only. / and /ping are plain @GetMapping methods on InsuranceApplication.
The frontend container serves the built bundle via nginx on port 80, published as FRONTEND_PORT (default 3000).

Postgres must come up with the pgvector extension before the backend: db/init/01-init-pgvector.sql is mounted into the image's entrypoint directory, and without it Flyway fails at V4__create_vector_embeddings_table.sql and the backend never starts. A backend that will not start after a database replacement is almost always this.
The backend requires OPENAI_API_KEY, JWT_SECRET and the DB credentials to be set; spring.ai.openai.api-key has no default and the context fails without it.
